description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: L-shaped sofa in upper-left corner facing into living room, second armchair below it; dining table near kitchen on right. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall left of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen, straight corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; households requiring a home office or dedicated workspace; people needing a bathtub; those wanting separated formal living and dining areas.
